systems.system: Base OISE (Outil informatisé de suivi évaluation) with an integrated PDESC module and a new digital platform: collects information on the collectivités territoriales, namely sessions held, projects, training and development programmes
systems.platform: rebuilt by a consultant, SITAN informatique, under the Projet communautaire de Relèvement et de Stabilisation au Sahel (PCRSS)
systems.owner: Direction générale des Collectivités territoriales (DGCT), Ministère de l'Administration territoriale et de la Décentralisation
systems.tiers: data on the collectivités territoriales; who enters the data, and where, is not stated beyond a planned user and deputy

note: A workshop of 2025-02-19 validating the rebuilt monitoring database on local governments, still before national validation and user training; the document does not say local government offices enter data in it or how they are connected.
